This is still Candidate/StaticOnly until those tests run on a frozen tree.

The current tree carries peer SETTINGS in the resumption application context, applies remembered/default settings during accepted 0-RTT, checks non-reduction and omission, and maps incompatible post-acceptance settings through a typed failure. Focused deterministic symbols cover encoding, compatibility, omission, accepted and rejected 0-RTT. This is Candidate/StaticOnly until execution and frozen-source review.

A bounded endpoint/configuration-keyed in-flight generation broker is wired into the real route path and deterministic actor tests cover joins, publication failure, leader exit, deadline, drain, close, and empty census. The current tests exercise the broker seam rather than observing two full concurrent authenticated HTTP/3 dials end to end, so the exact wire-level advisory remains short of direct evidence.
